intent: New store branding derived from the game's existing artwork

app_icon.prompt: Use case: logo-brand / ads-marketing. Transform the knight from the supplied InfiniteSlash sprite atlas into one finished Google Play app icon. Output a SINGLE square icon, exact 512x512 if supported, full-bleed opaque background, no rounded-corner mask, no border, no lettering, no badges, no watermark. This is whimsical medieval pixel-art action, one-thumb infinite slasher bullet hell. Preserve the knight's identity: slate-blue armor, gold trim, dark helmet visor with two bright square eyes, playful scarlet plume, short sturdy proportions. Make a highly readable chunky pixel-art close-up of the knight in a bold sweeping sword pose; silver blade and warm golden slash sweep form a striking diagonal, blue-gold shield visible. Hero takes 75 percent of the icon and remains legible at 48 pixels. A vibrant jewel-teal background with just two tiny silly monster silhouettes at the edges suggests cheerful chaos. Pixel artwork must be crisp and intentional, large clean pixel clusters, dark charcoal outlines, limited coherent palette, polished highlights, no photorealism, no smooth 3D. Main eyes, helmet and sword stay inside the central 70 percent circular safe area. Energetic, funny, memorable, immediate contrast. Render final as PNG and keep the complete artwork within its square.

feature_graphic.layout_edit_prompt: Precise layout edit of the supplied InfiniteSlash feature graphic. Keep the artwork, knight, monsters, forest, castle, gold slash, palette, pixel style, and exact 1024x500 landscape proportion. Change ONLY the placement/size of the title and tagline so they remain intact if the graphic is cropped from the sides to 16:9. Remove their old lettering cleanly and place the same title EXACTLY 'InfiniteSlash' and tagline EXACTLY 'One thumb. Endless trouble.' in the center-left. The entire lettering including outlines must start at least 12 percent of the full image width from the left edge and finish before 56 percent of the width. Title top around40 percent of image height, tagline beneath. Slightly smaller lettering if necessary, same bold warm-cream pixel type, same dark outlines; keep it highly readable. The sword and hero face should remain in exactly the same region. Preserve all other artwork as closely as possible. No additional words, no new elements, no borders, full-bleed opaque RGB image.
feature_graphic.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one Google Play feature graphic for InfiniteSlash, exactly 1024x500 pixels (2.048:1 landscape), full-bleed opaque RGB art, no device frame, no UI mockup, no rounded corners, no price/ranking/download claims. Images 1 and 2 are identity references: knight sprite atlas and the actual game's whimsical monster collection. Image 3 is the selected app-icon palette/style reference; extend that visual world, do not duplicate its close-up composition. Rich chunky pixel illustration with charcoal outlines, slate-blue/gold knight armor, red plume, jewel teal foliage, warm meadow greens and gold energy slash. A tiny brave full-body knight at center-right sweeping a silver sword in an enormous luminous gold arc through a comic crowd of roughly eight uniquely colored absurd monsters, with a crowned boss looming behind. A lush rolling forest/road supplies depth and the impression of endless hordes. Cute expressive faces, playful action, no gore. Preserve the hero identity and use monsters visually based on the supplied roster. At center-left within safe inner margins place exceptionally readable warm-cream bold custom pixel title EXACTLY 'InfiniteSlash' as one word, with a dark outline. Beneath it place EXACT smaller tagline 'One thumb. Endless trouble.' All important text and hero face inside central 80 percent width and 75 percent height so cropping stays safe. Keep visual hierarchy strong: title, knight, gold slash, then monsters. Leave enough breathing room around text and do not crowd it with monsters. High-impact commercial pixel illustration, crisp clean clusters, not 3D, not photorealistic. The only lettering is the specified title and tagline; spell them accurately.

formatting: Original artwork is preserved. tools/prepare_store_brand.ps1 performs aspect-preserving size/PNG-format conversion to the requested upload dimensions; it does not redraw the artwork.
